idiom.note: raw pinned threads + one bounded SPSC ring per (worker, worker) pair; block-row bi owned by worker bi * cores / grid; a tile travels as a pointer; not an actor framework and not ranked as one

caveats: THIS IS NOT A FRAMEWORK. Blocks are integers and a tile is one ring push and one ring pop per neighbour; the phase is the spec's compute(), the same as every framework's
block-row bi lives on worker bi * cores / grid -- qb's placement: at cores=2 a block's row neighbours share its worker and half its column neighbours do not
wait=1 busy-polls the rings; wait=0 parks an idle worker on a condition variable
